content.rendered:
A public meeting of the Budget Committee of the Sherwood School District, Washington County, Oregon, to discuss the budget for the fiscal year July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2025, will take place on Thursday, May 23, 2024, at 6:00 p.m. The meeting will be held in the District Office Boardroom, 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd., Sherwood, OR 97140.

This will be an in-person public meeting. To view a live stream of this meeting, please visit the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3

The purpose of the meeting is to receive the budget message and to receive comment from the public on the budget. This is a public meeting where deliberation of the Budget Committee will take place. Any person may make public comment on the proposed budget to the Budget Committee.

A copy of the budget document will be available on the district’s website on or after Friday, May 17.  A copy of the budget document may be inspected or obtained at the Sherwood School District Office, 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd., Sherwood, OR 97140, between the hours of 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM on or after Friday, May 17.

In the event that the Budget Committee meeting is continued to a future date, the following days and times have been tentatively reserved:

Wednesday, May 29, 2024 – 6:00 p.m.
Thursday, May 30, 2024 – 6:00 p.m.
